title: SAME-R 55 · Lampwick

source.fileDateDiscrepancy: Filename contains2010_211; original timestamps use2010/210, matching table29-Jul. No date correction applied.

sampling.method: All original data rows, in original order; elapsed time derived from original TimeString. No resampling, averaging, interpolation, sign reversal or normalization.
sampling.duplicateTimestampPolicy: Retain both original rows; sourceRow disambiguates. A cursor selects an original row, not an invented averaged measurement.

columns.label: Elapsed time from log start
columns.derivation: Parsed YYYY/day-of-year/HH:MM:SS; subtract first source timestamp; no resampling.

limitations: SAME-R is a controlled thermal pyrolysis and smoke aerosol measurement experiment. Heating flag does not represent open flaming or spontaneous fire ignition.
Mixing fan state is an internal canister operation; distinct from general cabin ventilation or BASS duct airflow.
ISS scattering channel preserves original negative voltage offsets from the source sheet without synthetic inversion or conversion to mass density.
STS alarm channel remains zero throughout the test run; continuous scattering voltage channels should be evaluated.
Table records 60 s heating time. Raw flag is active between 398–452 s (54 s span; 55 rows); preserved without synthetic alteration.
TestNumber and TestRunning states vary at run boundaries. Not all file rows represent active Test 55 conditions.
PTrak -999/500000 saturation codes and DustTrakA zero values are preserved in original format.
